results.title: Shugabannin ƙasashen kudu maso gabashin Asiya na gudanar da taro a Manila
results.content: A birnin Manila ne shugabannin ƙasashen kudu maso gabashin Asiya ke tattaunawa kan ciniki, tsaro, da matsalar makamashi a yau lahadi,taron da ake kyautata zaton Donald Trump shugaban Amurka zai halarci wannan taro ranat talata.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Iran ta kai hari sansanin sojojin Amurka a Bahrain inda aka ji fashewar abubuwa
results.content: An ji karar fashewar abubuwa a safiyar yau lahadi a Bahrain, inda Iran ta yi ikirarin kai hari kan sansanin Amurka da ke yankin Gulf da jiragen sama marasa matuki.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Kotunan Jordan sun yanke wa mutane uku hukuncin kisa ta hanyar rataya
results.content: A Jordan,kotun tsaron jiha ta yanke hukunci a safiyar yau lahadi, inda ta yanke wa mutane uku da suka kai hari a cocin Orthodox na Girka a Karaka garin Hammoud, hukuncin kisa a ranar 23 ga Oktoba," in ji rundunar sojin Jordan.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Maiɗakin Gwamnan Abba ta maka shi a kotu, don neman alƙali ya raba aurensu
results.content: Mai ɗakin gwamnan jihar Kano ta arewacin Najeriya Abba Kabir Yusuf wato Zainab Musa Kwankwaso, ta shigar da ƙarar kotu, inda take neman alƙali ya raba aurensu.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Guatemala ta ayyana dokar hana zirga-zirga ta kwanaki 30 a sassan Zacapa
results.content: Hukumomin ƙasar Guatemala sun ayyana dokar zirga-zirga ta kwanaki 30 a sassan Zacapa, inda aka kashe akalla mutane 17 a hare-haren makamai a cikin ƴan makonnin nan, da kuma Izabal, dukkansu suna kan iyaka da Honduras,wuraren da suka yi kaurin suna a bangaren safarar miyagun kwayoyi.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: An ɗage zaɓen Sudan ta kudu zuwa ranar 11 ga watan Fabrairun 2027
results.content: A Sudan ta kudu, a jiya asabar ce hukumomin suka sanar da ɗage zaɓen da aka shirya yi a ranar 22 ga watan Disamba zuwa ranar 11 ga watan Fabrairun 2027. Wannan zaɓe, wanda shi ne na farko a tarihin ƙasar da ta samu ‘yancin kai a shekarar 2011,karo na uku kenan da ake ɗage zaɓen ƙasar wanda a baya aka yi hakan sau biyu, a shekarar 2022 da 2024.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Ƴansandan Korea ta Kudu na tsare da dalibin da ya fi samun maki a jarrabawar ƙasar
results.content: Ƴansandan Korea ta Kudu a yau lahadi,bayan bincike sun samu nasarar cafke dalibin da ya fi samun maki a jarrabawar lissafin haraji ta ƙasar a wanan shekarar 2026, wanda ya amsa laifin tare da yin amfani da fasahar kirkirar basira ta AI.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ana alhinin tunawa da mutane 130 da suka mutu a harin ta'addancin 2015 a birnin Paris
results.content: Ƙasar Faransa na bikin cika shekaru 11 da hare-haren ta'addancin da aka kai birnin Paris a watan Nuwamban 2015, inda aka kashe mutane 130.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: An ɗage zaɓen Sudan ta Kudu zuwa watan Fabrairun baɗi
results.content: Ƙasar Sudan ta Kudu ta ɗage gudanar da babban zaɗen ƙasar zuwa ranar 11 ga watan Fabrairun 2027, kamar yadda hukumar zaɓen ƙasar ta sanar.

results.title: Mutane 10 sun mutu a wata aramgama tsakanin masu haƙar zinare da jami'an tsaro a Guinea
results.content: Aƙalla mutane 10 ne suka mutu sakamakon arangama tsakanin jami’an tsaro da masu haƙar zinare a yankin da ake samun zinare a arewa maso gabashin ƙasar Guinea ba bisa ƙa’ida ba.

results.title: DRC ta dakatar da Juliana Lumumba daga neman shugabancin ƙungiyar IOF
results.content: A jajibirin taron ƙolin ƙungiyar ƙasashen masu amfani da harshen Faransanci ta duniya, OIF, karo na 20, da za a gudanar a birnin Phnom Penh na ƙasar Cambodia a ranakun 15 da 16 ga watan Nuwamba, Jamhuriyar Dimokuraɗiyyar Congo ta nuna aniyarta ta janye takarar Juliana Lumumba daga neman kujerar sakatariyar ƙungiyar.

results.title: Sojojin Mali sun farmaki ƴan ta'adda bayan wasu hare-hare da suka kai kan fararen hula
results.content: Rundunar sojin Mali ta ce ta kai hare-haren sama kan wuraren da ta bayyana a matsayin maboyar ƴan ta'adda a yankunan Kadiana da ke jihar Bougouni, da kuma Boulkessi a jihar Douentza, ranar Juma'a 13 ga Nuwamban 2026.

results.title: Afrika ta Kudu ta zargi Najeriya da yin ƙarya kan hulɗar diplomasiyyar ƙasashen biyu
results.content: Najeriya da Afirka ta Kudu sun sake samun saɓani a hulɗar diflomasiyya, bayan kakakin shugaban ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu, Cyril Ramaphosa, ya zargi babban ofishin jakadancin Najeriya da yin ƙarya kan iƙirarin cewa shugaban ƙasar ya sa baki bayan cire jawabin Ambasada Femi Fani-Kayode daga cikin shirye-shiryen da gidan talabijin na ƙasar ya watsa na wani bikin diflomasiyya.

results.title: Ƴan ta'adda sun hallaka mutane 44 a wasu hare-hare da suka kai lardin Kivu na DRC
results.content: Aƙalla fararen hula 44 ne suka mutu sakamakon hare-haren wasu ƴan bindiga masu alaƙa da ƙungiyar IS a arewa maso gabashin Jamhuriyar Dimokuraɗiyyar Congo a wannan makon, kamar yadda majiyoyin jin ƙai da tsaro na ƙasar ne suka bayyana hakan.

results.title: Burkina Faso ta bayar da sammacin kamo wasu mutane 20 da ke wajen ƙasar
results.content: Ƙasar Burkina Faso ta bayar da sammacin kamawa tare da miƙa wa hukumomi wasu mutane 20, ciki har da ƴan jarida da ke gudun hijira, masu fafutuka, tsohon minista da kuma tsoffin jami'an soji.

results.title: Lokaci yayi da Iran da Amurka zasu bada damar jigilar takin zamani ta mashigin Hormuz-MDD
results.content: Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta yi kira ga ƙasashen Iran da Amurka da su gaggauta ba da damar jigilar takin zamani ta mashigar ruwan Hormuz, domin rage matsin tattalin arziki da ake fuskanta a wasu ƙasashe masu rauni.

results.title: Yaran jihar Borno da aka yi garkuwa da su, sun cika kwanaki 213 ba tare da jin ɗuriyarsu ba
results.content: Yayin yaƙin neman zaɓe ke ƙara kankama a Najeriya, iyalan yaran da aka sace a jihohin Borno da Neja na ci gaba da jiran tsammanin ganin dawowar yaransu.
